142	## Order and failure
143	- Rows are plain inserts. A duplicate primary key makes the statement fail, and the files have no handler.
144	- Nothing is committed in a defined order across the files.
145	
146	## Connections
147	- **`webERP/sql/updates/5.php`** (database migration for version 2.9) is a second writer of the same rows.
148	  - It creates `modules` (`secroleid`, `modulelink` primary key, `modulename`, `sequence`) and `menuitems`.
149	  - It then calls `NewModule()` for the 11 modules with sequences 1–11, and `NewMenuItem(module, section, label, path, order)` about 107+ times, followed by the system and Utilities items.
150	  - It ends with `UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Move the menu and module strings to the database'))`, called only if `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0`.
151	  - Its Utilities Maintenance has 13 items. Two are absent from the install seed: "Re-calculate brought forward amounts in GL" (`/Z_UpdateChartDetailsBFwd.php`) and "Re-Post all GL transactions from a specified period" (`/Z_RePostGLFromPeriod.php`).
152	  - The install seed has Utilities Maintenance sequences 9, 12 and 13 but not 10 and 11.
153	  - GL Maintenance in the upgrade has 12 items, GL Reports 18 and stock Reports 21. The install seed is a later snapshot with more rows. Later updates such as `webERP/sql/updates/15.php` and `16.php` alter the menu further (behaviour of those not read here).
154	- **`webERP/includes/MainMenuLinksArray.php`** reads the tables at login.
155	  - It unsets `$_SESSION['ModuleLink']`, `ReportList`, `ModuleList` and `MenuItems`.
156	  - It selects from `modules` where `secroleid = $_SESSION['AccessLevel']`, ordered by `sequence`.
157	  - It selects from `menuitems` where `secroleid = $_SESSION['AccessLevel']`, ordered by `sequence`, then `menusection`.
158	  - It stores the `modulelink` as `$ModuleLink[]`, the `reportlink` as `$ReportList[modulelink]`, and `__(modulename)` as `$ModuleList[]`.
159	  - It stores `__(caption)` and `url` under `$MenuItems[modulelink][menusection]['Caption'|'URL'][]`.
160	  - It has no error handler and no check on `AccessLevel`.
161	- **`webERP/sql/demo.sql`** also contains `menuitems` (its content was not read).
162	- **`webERP/includes/UpgradeDB_*.php`** (mysql, mysqli, mariadb, postgres) also mention `menuitems` (content not read).
163	
164	## Conclusions
165	- The menu is selected by `secroleid` equal to the user's `AccessLevel`. A user whose access level has no rows in `menuitems` or `modules` gets an empty menu. The seeds give rows for ids 1–9 only, so any other id gets no module or menu rows. A user who is not in 1–9 sees nothing.
166	- The `modules` seed covers ids 1–9, all with the same 11 modules. There is no per-role restriction in the data, so restriction can only come from `menuitems` rows being absent for a role.
167	- The `menuitems` primary key includes `caption`, so one caption cannot repeat within a role, module and section. This is why "Select Supplier" appears in both AP Maintenance and AP Transactions.
168	- The install seed and the upgrade script `5.php` insert the same menu rows by different routes. A new install and an upgraded database can therefore differ. For example, only the upgrade adds the two `/Z_UpdateChartDetailsBFwd.php` and `/Z_RePostGLFromPeriod.php` items.
169	- `PO_SelectOSPurchOrder.php` is registered under stock Transactions as "Receive Purchase Orders" and under PO Transactions as "Purchase Orders". `/SelectSalesOrder.php` and `/SelectSupplier.php` also appear in two sections each.
170	- Running the inserts twice fails on the primary key, so the seed is not repeatable without clearing the tables first.
171	- `systypes` ids 500 and 600 are the auto-number counters for debtors and suppliers.
172	
173	## Hazards
174	- Paths are not checked against real scripts, and the url column is varchar(60). The `&` encoding is stored literally.
175	- The install seed and the upgrade scripts keep separate copies of the menu list. A change to one does not reach the other.

# webERP install seed data: menu items, module list and transaction types

Part of [webERP installer, seed data, schema, build/CI and project-history area](weberp-installer-seed-data-schema-build-ci-and-project-histo-150/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

The topic holds three SQL seed files for the install database: `menuitems` rows, `modules` rows and `systypes` rows. Nothing runs inside the files. The installer loads them, and the application reads `menuitems` and `modules` to build the main menu.

## Contract
- **Takes in:** literal SQL `INSERT` statements only. Nothing is validated or converted.
- **Writes to:** three tables.
  - `menuitems` (schema in `webERP/install/sql/tables/menuitems.sql`):
    - Columns: `secroleid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 8, `modulelink` varchar(10), `menusection` varchar(15), `caption` varchar(60), `url` varchar(60), `sequence` int DEFAULT 1.
    - Primary key: (`secroleid`, `modulelink`, `menusection`, `caption`).
    - No index on `url` or `sequence`, and no foreign key on `secroleid`.
  - `modules`: tuples (role/company id, `modulelink`, `reportlink` dir, `modulename`, `sequence`).
  - `systypes`: (`typeid`, `typename`, and one numeric field that is 0 in every row).
- **`menuitems` row shape:** (`secroleid`, module, section, caption, url, sequence).
  - Modules: `Sales`, `AR`, `PO`, `AP`, `stock`, `manuf`, `GL`, `FA`, `PC`, `system`, `Utilities`.
  - Sections: `Maintenance`, `Reports`, `Transactions`.
  - Fixture variants: one rendering of the file shows `secroleid` 1 and others show 2–9 for different blocks. Several blocks carry a role id 2–9 or "version 2 or 3". The first column is the role id, and the rows are repeated per role id 1–9.
  - Query strings keep the `&` encoding, for example `/CustomerReceipt.php?NewReceipt=Yes&Type=GL`.
  - `ProdSpecGroups.php` ("Product Spec Groups Maintenance", `manuf` Maintenance, sequence 9) appears for role ids 1–9.
- **`modules` seed:** 11 modules for each of 9 role ids (99 rows), in the same order for every id. The values are (module, dir, sequence):

| Module | Dir | Sequence |
|---|---|---|
| Sales | ord | 1 |
| AR | ar | 2 |
| PO | prch | 3 |
| AP | ap | 4 |
| stock | inv | 5 |
| manuf | man | 6 |
| GL | gl | 7 |
| FA | fa | 8 |
| PC | pc | 9 |
| system | sys | 10 |
| Utilities | util | 11 |

- **`systypes` seed:**
  - Journal - GL 0, Payment - GL 1, Receipt - GL 2, Standing Journal 3, Journal Template Number 4.
  - Sales Invoice 10, Credit Note 11, Receipt 12, Journal - Debtors 15, Location Transfer 16, Stock Adjustment 17, Purchase Order 18, Picking List 19.
  - Purchase Invoice 20, Debit Note 21, Creditors Payment 22, Creditors Journal 23, Purchase Order Delivery 25.
  - Work Order Receipt 26, Work Order Issue 28, Work Order Variance 29, Sales Order 30, Shipment Close 31, Contract Close 32.
  - Cost Update 35, Exchange Difference 36, Tenders 37, Stock Requests 38, Sales Commision Accruals 39 (spelled so in the data).
  - Work Order 40, Asset Addition 41, Asset Category Change 42, Delete w/down asset 43, Depreciation 44.
  - Import Fixed Assets 49, Opening Balance 50, Auto Debtor Number 500, Auto Supplier Number 600.

## Entry points
None. These are data files with no handlers or guards. There is no check that a path exists, no deduplication, and no per-user condition. The only guard is the `menuitems` primary key, which rejects a repeated (`secroleid`, `modulelink`, `menusection`, `caption`).

## Decisions
There are no branches. The data is declarative.

### Menu content by module, section and count
Entries come from the fixtures. Where the fixtures differ, the larger list is given.

- **AP**
  - Maintenance: Add Supplier `/Suppliers.php` 1, Select Supplier `/SelectSupplier.php` 2, Maintain Factor Companies `/Factors.php` 3.
  - Reports (8): `/AgedSuppliers.php`, `/PDFSuppTransListing.php`, `/OutstandingGRNs.php`, `/SuppPaymentRun.php`, `/PDFRemittanceAdvice.php`, `/SupplierBalsAtPeriodEnd.php`, `/SupplierTransInquiry.php`, `/SuppWhereAlloc.php`.
  - Transactions: `/SelectSupplier.php` 1, `/SupplierAllocations.php` 2.
- **AR**
  - Maintenance: `/Customers.php` 1, `/SelectCustomer.php` 2.
  - Reports (10): `/AgedDebtors.php`, `/CustomerBalancesMovement.php`, `/PDFCustomerList.php`, `/CustomerTransInquiry.php`, `/DebtorsAtPeriodEnd.php`, `/PDFCustTransListing.php`, `/PrintCustTrans.php`, `/PrintCustStatements.php`, `/PDFBankingSummary.php`, `/CustWhereAlloc.php`.
  - Transactions (4):

## Order and failure
- Rows are plain inserts. A duplicate primary key makes the statement fail, and the files have no handler.
- Nothing is committed in a defined order across the files.

## Connections
- **`webERP/sql/updates/5.php`** (database migration for version 2.9) is a second writer of the same rows.
  - It creates `modules` (`secroleid`, `modulelink` primary key, `modulename`, `sequence`) and `menuitems`.
  - It then calls `NewModule()` for the 11 modules with sequences 1–11, and `NewMenuItem(module, section, label, path, order)` about 107+ times, followed by the system and Utilities items.
  - It ends with `UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Move the menu and module strings to the database'))`, called only if `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0`.
  - Its Utilities Maintenance has 13 items. Two are absent from the install seed: "Re-calculate brought forward amounts in GL" (`/Z_UpdateChartDetailsBFwd.php`) and "Re-Post all GL transactions from a specified period" (`/Z_RePostGLFromPeriod.php`).
  - The install seed has Utilities Maintenance sequences 9, 12 and 13 but not 10 and 11.
  - GL Maintenance in the upgrade has 12 items, GL Reports 18 and stock Reports 21. The install seed is a later snapshot with more rows. Later updates such as `webERP/sql/updates/15.php` and `16.php` alter the menu further (behaviour of those not read here).
- **`webERP/includes/MainMenuLinksArray.php`** reads the tables at login.
  - It unsets `$_SESSION['ModuleLink']`, `ReportList`, `ModuleList` and `MenuItems`.
  - It selects from `modules` where `secroleid = $_SESSION['AccessLevel']`, ordered by `sequence`.
  - It selects from `menuitems` where `secroleid = $_SESSION['AccessLevel']`, ordered by `sequence`, then `menusection`.
  - It stores the `modulelink` as `$ModuleLink[]`, the `reportlink` as `$ReportList[modulelink]`, and `__(modulename)` as `$ModuleList[]`.
  - It stores `__(caption)` and `url` under `$MenuItems[modulelink][menusection]['Caption'|'URL'][]`.
  - It has no error handler and no check on `AccessLevel`.
- **`webERP/sql/demo.sql`** also contains `menuitems` (its content was not read).
- **`webERP/includes/UpgradeDB_*.php`** (mysql, mysqli, mariadb, postgres) also mention `menuitems` (content not read).

## Conclusions
- The menu is selected by `secroleid` equal to the user's `AccessLevel`. A user whose access level has no rows in `menuitems` or `modules` gets an empty menu. The seeds give rows for ids 1–9 only, so any other id gets no module or menu rows. A user who is not in 1–9 sees nothing.
- The `modules` seed covers ids 1–9, all with the same 11 modules. There is no per-role restriction in the data, so restriction can only come from `menuitems` rows being absent for a role.
- The `menuitems` primary key includes `caption`, so one caption cannot repeat within a role, module and section. This is why "Select Supplier" appears in both AP Maintenance and AP Transactions.
- The install seed and the upgrade script `5.php` insert the same menu rows by different routes. A new install and an upgraded database can therefore differ. For example, only the upgrade adds the two `/Z_UpdateChartDetailsBFwd.php` and `/Z_RePostGLFromPeriod.php` items.
- `PO_SelectOSPurchOrder.php` is registered under stock Transactions as "Receive Purchase Orders" and under PO Transactions as "Purchase Orders". `/SelectSalesOrder.php` and `/SelectSupplier.php` also appear in two sections each.
- Running the inserts twice fails on the primary key, so the seed is not repeatable without clearing the tables first.
- `systypes` ids 500 and 600 are the auto-number counters for debtors and suppliers.

## Hazards
- Paths are not checked against real scripts, and the url column is varchar(60). The `&` encoding is stored literally.
- The install seed and the upgrade scripts keep separate copies of the menu list. A change to one does not reach the other.

<?php

/* Shared credit control functions: customer credit status, the credit control audit log, held orders,
overdue invoices and the posting of debtor adjustments (interest, fees, waivers and write-offs).

The credit status of a customer is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, whose holdreasons row says what it means:
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 1  the customer is ON STOP
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 2  the customer is on WATCH
	anything else                       normal
*/

/* The security token of the credit controller, the deputy and the Finance Director. Token 22 is the Finance Director's approval of large write-offs */
define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 21);
define('CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN', 22);

/* The transaction types written to debtortrans by credit control */
define('CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE', 45);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER', 46);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 47);

function CreditUserCan($Token = CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN) {
	return isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) and in_array($Token, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* A SQL expression for the date an invoice falls due - the same rule the aged debtors report uses */
function CreditDueDateSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(last_day(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END";
}

/* Returns the credit status of a customer */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Status = array('code' => 0,
					'description' => '',
					'type' => 0,
					'stop' => false,
					'watch' => false);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
		$Status['code'] = $MyRow['holdreason'];
		$Status['description'] = $MyRow['reasondescription'];
		$Status['type'] = $MyRow['dissallowinvoices'];
		$Status['stop'] = ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1);
		$Status['watch'] = ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2);
	}
	return $Status;
}

/* The word shown to staff for a holdreasons.dissallowinvoices value */
function CreditStatusText($DisallowInvoices) {
	if ($DisallowInvoices == 1) {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($DisallowInvoices == 2) {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* Shows a banner when the customer is on stop or on watch. $ForCustomer hides the reason and the watch status from the customer themselves */
function CreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo, $ForCustomer = false) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Status['stop']) {
		if ($ForCustomer) {
			prnMsg(__('Your account is on hold. Please contact us to discuss before placing further orders.'), 'warn');
		} else {
			prnMsg(__('This customer is ON STOP') . ' - ' . $Status['description'] . '. ' . __('No orders can be accepted or dispatched without release by credit control'), 'error');
		}
	} elseif ($Status['watch'] and !$ForCustomer) {
		prnMsg(__('This customer is on WATCH') . ' - ' . $Status['description'] . '. ' . __('Orders may be taken but please contact credit control to discuss'), 'warn');
	}
	return $Status;
}

/* Writes a row to the credit control history of a customer. Rows are never updated or deleted */
function CreditLogEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Notes = '', $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $Amount = 0, $CurrCode = '') {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									eventdate,
									eventtype,
									userid,
									oldvalue,
									newvalue,
									amount,
									currcode,
									notes)
			VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					NOW(),
					'" . $EventType . "',
					'" . (isset($_SESSION['UserID']) ? $_SESSION['UserID'] : '') . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($OldValue, 0, 100)) . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($NewValue, 0, 100)) . "',
					'" . (float) $Amount . "',
					'" . $CurrCode . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Notes) . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be written because'));
}

/* The next review date is today plus the standard review period set by Finance (CreditReviewMonths in the config) */
function CreditNextReviewDate($Months = '') {
	if ($Months === '') {
		$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths']) ? $_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths'] : 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('n') + (int) $Months, date('j'), date('Y')));
}

/* Changes the credit status of a customer and records who, when and why */
function CreditSetStatus($DebtorNo, $NewReasonCode, $Notes) {
	$Old = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Old['code'] == $NewReasonCode) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster
				SET holdreason = '" . (int) $NewReasonCode . "'
				WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status could not be updated because'));
	$New = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	CreditLogEvent($DebtorNo, 'status', $Notes, $Old['description'] . ' (' . CreditStatusText($Old['type']) . ')', $New['description'] . ' (' . CreditStatusText($New['type']) . ')');
	return true;
}

/* The first holdreasons code of a type (1 = stop, 2 = watch, 0 = normal), or false if none is defined */
function CreditFirstReasonOfType($Type) {
	if ($Type == 0) {
		$SQL = "SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices <= 0 ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1";
	} else {
		$SQL = "SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = '" . (int) $Type . "' ORDER BY reasoncode LIMIT 1";
	}
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

/* Whether the logged in user may see the credit information of a customer. Sales reps see only their own customers
and a customer login sees only its own account */
function CreditUserMaySee($DebtorNo) {
	if (!empty($_SESSION['CustomerLogin']) and $_SESSION['CustomerLogin'] == 1) {
		return ($_SESSION['CustomerID'] == $DebtorNo);
	}
	if (!empty($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'])) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
								AND salesman = '" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'");
		return (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* Why an order cannot be accepted for dispatch or invoicing, or an empty string if it can.
An order explicitly released by credit control is never blocked */
function CreditOrderBlockedReason($OrderNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT salesorders.creditheld,
					salesorders.creditreleased,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM salesorders
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . (int) $OrderNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return '';
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['creditreleased'] == 1) {
		return '';
	}
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		return __('the customer is on stop');
	}
	if ($MyRow['creditheld'] == 1) {
		return __('the order is held over the credit limit awaiting approval by credit control');
	}
	return '';
}

/* Called once the lines of a new or changed order are in the database. Holds the order for credit control's approval
when it takes the customer over their credit limit. Returns true if the order has been held. */
function CreditHoldOrderIfOverLimit($OrderNo) {
	if (isset($_SESSION['CreditHoldOverLimit']) and $_SESSION['CreditHoldOverLimit'] != 1) {
		return false;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, quotation, creditheld, creditreleased
						FROM salesorders
						WHERE orderno = '" . (int) $OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['quotation'] == 1 or $MyRow['creditreleased'] == 1) {
		return false;
	}
	if ($MyRow['creditheld'] == 1) {
		return true;
	}
	/* the order lines are already in the database so they are part of the credit available */
	if (GetCreditAvailable($MyRow['debtorno']) < 0) {
		DB_query("UPDATE salesorders SET creditheld = 1 WHERE orderno = '" . (int) $OrderNo . "'");
		CreditLogEvent($MyRow['debtorno'], 'orderheld', __('Order held for credit control approval - over the credit limit'), '', (string) $OrderNo);
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

/* The unsettled invoices and charges of a customer with the date each fell due and the days overdue as at $AsAtDate (Y-m-d) */
function CreditGetOpenInvoices($DebtorNo, $AsAtDate = '') {
	if ($AsAtDate == '') {
		$AsAtDate = date('Y-m-d');
	}
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.rate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					" . CreditDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					TO_DAYS('" . $AsAtDate . "') - TO_DAYS(" . CreditDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
				AND debtortrans.settled = 0
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0
			ORDER BY duedate, debtortrans.id";
	return DB_query($SQL);
}

/* The accounts contact email addresses of a customer - the contacts that receive statements */
function CreditContactEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Emails = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email FROM custcontacts
						WHERE statement = 1
							AND debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow[0])) {
			$Emails[] = $MyRow[0];
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* Posts one debtor adjustment (a charge, a waiver or a write-off) to the customer account and, when debtors are linked to the
general ledger, to the ledger. $Amount is in the currency of the customer: positive debits the customer, negative credits it.
$ContraAccount is the income or bad debt account. Must be called inside a transaction.
Returns array('id' => debtortrans id, 'transno' => transaction number, 'rate' => exchange rate used) */
function CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Reference, $Text, $ContraAccount, $Rate = 0) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
								currencies.rate,
								currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN currencies
							ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Debtor = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Rate == 0) {
		$Rate = $Debtor['rate'];
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT branchcode, salesman
						FROM custbranch
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						ORDER BY branchcode
						LIMIT 1");
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $Debtor['decimalplaces']);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					'" . $Type . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					CURRENT_DATE,
					NOW(),
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reference, 0, 50)) . "',
					'" . $Debtor['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer transaction could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = $Amount / $Rate;
		$Narrative = mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Reference . ' ' . $Text, 0, 200);
		$GLSQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							CURRENT_DATE,
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
							'" . $HomeAmount . "')";
		DB_query($GLSQL, __('The debtors control GL posting could not be inserted because'), '', true);
		$GLSQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							CURRENT_DATE,
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $ContraAccount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
							'" . -$HomeAmount . "')";
		DB_query($GLSQL, __('The GL posting to the income or bad debt account could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'rate' => $Rate);
}

/* Allocates a credit (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit, the same way CustomerAllocations.php does.
$Amount is positive and in the currency of the customer. Returns the exchange difference of the allocation in home currency. */
function CreditAllocate($CreditID, $CreditRate, $DebitID, $DebitRate, $Amount, $Decimals) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . $CreditID . "', '" . $DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$Decimals);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . ",
					settled = IF(ABS(ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount - (alloc + " . $Amount . ")) < " . $Tolerance . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $DebitID . "'",
			__('The allocated transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);
	return ($Amount / $CreditRate) - ($Amount / $DebitRate);
}

/* Settles the credit transaction after its allocations: it is fully allocated when the allocations equal its amount */
function CreditSettleTrans($CreditID, $TotalAllocated, $TotalDiffOnExch, $Decimals) {
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$Decimals);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc = -" . $TotalAllocated . ",
					diffonexch = -" . $TotalDiffOnExch . ",
					settled = IF(ABS(ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount + " . $TotalAllocated . ") < " . $Tolerance . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'",
			__('The credit transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);
}

/* Posts the exchange difference of the allocations of a credit to the ledger as CustomerAllocations.php does */
function CreditPostExchangeDifference($Type, $TransNo, $DiffOnExch) {
	if (abs($DiffOnExch) < 0.00001 or $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] != 1) {
		return;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Movement = -$DiffOnExch;
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . $Movement . "')",
			__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . -$Movement . "')",
			__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
}

/* Writes off $Amount (customer currency) of a customer's unpaid invoices, oldest first. Posts the write-off to the customer
account and the ledger. Must be called inside a transaction. Returns the debtortrans id and transno of the write-off. */
function CreditPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $Amount, $Reason, $BadDebtAccount) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT currencies.rate, currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN currencies ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Currency = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$Posted = CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, -$Amount, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Reason, $BadDebtAccount);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$TotalDiff = 0;
	$TotalAllocated = 0;
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, rate, balance
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
							AND settled = 0
							AND balance > 0
						ORDER BY trandate, id");
	while ($Open = DB_fetch_array($Result) and $Remaining > 0) {
		$Portion = min($Remaining, round($Open['balance'], $Currency['decimalplaces']));
		if ($Portion <= 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$TotalDiff += CreditAllocate($Posted['id'], $Posted['rate'], $Open['id'], $Open['rate'], $Portion, $Currency['decimalplaces']);
		$TotalAllocated += $Portion;
		$Remaining -= $Portion;
	}
	CreditSettleTrans($Posted['id'], $TotalAllocated, $TotalDiff, $Currency['decimalplaces']);
	CreditPostExchangeDifference(CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $Posted['transno'], $TotalDiff);
	return $Posted;
}

/* The unsettled debit balance of a customer in the customer currency */
function CreditWriteOffableBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0)
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
							AND settled = 0
							AND balance > 0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

Returns array('id' => debtortrans id, 'transno' => transaction number, 'rate' => exchange rate used) */
function CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Reference, $Text, $ContraAccount, $Rate = 0) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
								currencies.rate,
								currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN currencies
							ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Debtor = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Rate == 0) {
		$Rate = $Debtor['rate'];
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT branchcode, salesman
						FROM custbranch
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						ORDER BY branchcode
						LIMIT 1");
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $Debtor['decimalplaces']);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					'" . $Type . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					CURRENT_DATE,
					NOW(),
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reference, 0, 50)) . "',
					'" . $Debtor['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer transaction could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = $Amount / $Rate;
		$Narrative = mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Reference . ' ' . $Text, 0, 200);
		$GLSQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							CURRENT_DATE,
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
							'" . $HomeAmount . "')";
		DB_query($GLSQL, __('The debtors control GL posting could not be inserted because'), '', true);
		$GLSQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							CURRENT_DATE,
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $ContraAccount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
							'" . -$HomeAmount . "')";
		DB_query($GLSQL, __('The GL posting to the income or bad debt account could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'rate' => $Rate);
}

/* Allocates a credit (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit, the same way CustomerAllocations.php does.
$Amount is positive and in the currency of the customer. Returns the exchange difference of the allocation in home currency. */
function CreditAllocate($CreditID, $CreditRate, $DebitID, $DebitRate, $Amount, $Decimals) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . $CreditID . "', '" . $DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$Decimals);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . ",
					settled = IF(ABS(ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount - (alloc + " . $Amount . ")) < " . $Tolerance . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $DebitID . "'",
			__('The allocated transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);
	return ($Amount / $CreditRate) - ($Amount / $DebitRate);
}

/* Settles the credit transaction after its allocations: it is fully allocated when the allocations equal its amount */
function CreditSettleTrans($CreditID, $TotalAllocated, $TotalDiffOnExch, $Decimals) {
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$Decimals);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc = -" . $TotalAllocated . ",
					diffonexch = -" . $TotalDiffOnExch . ",
					settled = IF(ABS(ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount + " . $TotalAllocated . ") < " . $Tolerance . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'",
			__('The credit transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);
}

function CreditPostExchangeDifference($Type, $TransNo, $DiffOnExch) {

		return;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Movement = -$DiffOnExch;
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . $Movement . "')",
			__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . -$Movement . "')",
			__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
}

/* Writes off $Amount (customer currency) of a customer's unpaid invoices, oldest first. Posts the write-off to the customer
account and the ledger. Must be called inside a transaction. Returns the debtortrans id and transno of the write-off. */
function CreditPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $Amount, $Reason, $BadDebtAccount) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT currencies.rate, currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN currencies ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Currency = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$Posted = CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, -$Amount, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Reason, $BadDebtAccount);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$TotalDiff = 0;
	$TotalAllocated = 0;
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, rate, balance
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
							AND settled = 0
							AND balance > 0
						ORDER BY trandate, id");
	while ($Open = DB_fetch_array($Result) and $Remaining > 0) {
		$Portion = min($Remaining, round($Open['balance'], $Currency['decimalplaces']));
		if ($Portion <= 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$TotalDiff += CreditAllocate($Posted['id'], $Posted['rate'], $Open['id'], $Open['rate'], $Portion, $Currency['decimalplaces']);
		$TotalAllocated += $Portion;
		$Remaining -= $Portion;
	}
	CreditSettleTrans($Posted['id'], $TotalAllocated, $TotalDiff, $Currency['decimalplaces']);
	CreditPostExchangeDifference(CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $Posted['transno'], $TotalDiff);
	return $Posted;
}

/* The unsettled debit balance of a customer in the customer currency */
function CreditWriteOffableBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0)
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
							AND settled = 0
							AND balance > 0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

						WHERE statement = 1
							AND debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow[0])) {
			$Emails[] = $MyRow[0];
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* Posts one debtor adjustment (a charge, a waiver or a write-off) to the customer account and, when debtors are linked to the
general ledger, to the ledger. $Amount is in the currency of the customer: positive debits the customer, negative credits it.
$ContraAccount is the income or bad debt account. Must be called inside a transaction.
Returns array('id' => debtortrans id, 'transno' => transaction number, 'rate' => exchange rate used) */
function CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Reference, $Text, $ContraAccount, $Rate = 0) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.salestype,
								currencies.rate,
								currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN currencies
							ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Debtor = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Rate == 0) {
		$Rate = $Debtor['rate'];
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT branchcode, salesman
						FROM custbranch
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						ORDER BY branchcode
						LIMIT 1");
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$Amount = round($Amount, $Debtor['decimalplaces']);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
			VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
					'" . $Type . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
					'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
					CURRENT_DATE,
					NOW(),
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reference, 0, 50)) . "',
					'" . $Debtor['salestype'] . "',
					'" . $Rate . "',
					'" . $Amount . "',
					'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
					'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer transaction could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = $Amount / $Rate;
		$Narrative = mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Reference . ' ' . $Text, 0, 200);
		$GLSQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							CURRENT_DATE,
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
							'" . $HomeAmount . "')";
		DB_query($GLSQL, __('The debtors control GL posting could not be inserted because'), '', true);
		$GLSQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							CURRENT_DATE,
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $ContraAccount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
							'" . -$HomeAmount . "')";
		DB_query($GLSQL, __('The GL posting to the income or bad debt account could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	}
	return array('id' => $TransID, 'transno' => $TransNo, 'rate' => $Rate);
}

/* Allocates a credit (a waiver or a write-off) to a debit, the same way CustomerAllocations.php does.
$Amount is positive and in the currency of the customer. Returns the exchange difference of the allocation in home currency. */
function CreditAllocate($CreditID, $CreditRate, $DebitID, $DebitRate, $Amount, $Decimals) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . $CreditID . "', '" . $DebitID . "')",
			__('The allocation could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$Decimals);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . ",
					settled = IF(ABS(ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount - (alloc + " . $Amount . ")) < " . $Tolerance . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $DebitID . "'",
			__('The allocated transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);
	return ($Amount / $CreditRate) - ($Amount / $DebitRate);
}

/* Settles the credit transaction after its allocations: it is fully allocated when the allocations equal its amount */
function CreditSettleTrans($CreditID, $TotalAllocated, $TotalDiffOnExch, $Decimals) {
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$Decimals);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc = -" . $TotalAllocated . ",
					diffonexch = -" . $TotalDiffOnExch . ",
					settled = IF(ABS(ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount + " . $TotalAllocated . ") < " . $Tolerance . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'",
			__('The credit transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);
}

/* Posts the exchange difference of the allocations of a credit to the ledger as CustomerAllocations.php does */
function CreditPostExchangeDifference($Type, $TransNo, $DiffOnExch) {
	if (abs($DiffOnExch) < 0.00001 or $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] != 1) {
		return;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Movement = -$DiffOnExch;
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . $Movement . "')",
			__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . -$Movement . "')",
			__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
}

/* Writes off $Amount (customer currency) of a customer's unpaid invoices, oldest first. Posts the write-off to the customer
account and the ledger. Must be called inside a transaction. Returns the debtortrans id and transno of the write-off. */
function CreditPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $Amount, $Reason, $BadDebtAccount) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT currencies.rate, currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN currencies ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Currency = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$Posted = CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, -$Amount, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Reason, $BadDebtAccount);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$TotalDiff = 0;
	$TotalAllocated = 0;
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, rate, balance
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
							AND settled = 0
							AND balance > 0
						ORDER BY trandate, id");
	while ($Open = DB_fetch_array($Result) and $Remaining > 0) {
		$Portion = min($Remaining, round($Open['balance'], $Currency['decimalplaces']));
		if ($Portion <= 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$TotalDiff += CreditAllocate($Posted['id'], $Posted['rate'], $Open['id'], $Open['rate'], $Portion, $Currency['decimalplaces']);
		$TotalAllocated += $Portion;
		$Remaining -= $Portion;
	}
	CreditSettleTrans($Posted['id'], $TotalAllocated, $TotalDiff, $Currency['decimalplaces']);
	CreditPostExchangeDifference(CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $Posted['transno'], $TotalDiff);
	return $Posted;
}

/* The unsettled debit balance of a customer in the customer currency */
function CreditWriteOffableBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0)
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
							AND settled = 0
							AND balance > 0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

<?php

/* Shared credit control functions: customer credit status, the credit control audit log, held orders,
overdue invoices and the posting of debtor adjustments (interest, fees, waivers and write-offs).

The credit status of a customer is the existing debtorsmaster.holdreason, whose holdreasons row says what it means:
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 1  the customer is ON STOP
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 2  the customer is on WATCH
	anything else                       normal
*/

/* The security token of the credit controller, the deputy and the Finance Director. Token 22 is the Finance Director's approval of large write-offs */
define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 21);
define('CREDIT_APPROVAL_TOKEN', 22);

/* The transaction types written to debtortrans by credit control */
define('CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE', 45);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER', 46);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 47);

function CreditUserCan($Token = CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN) {
	return isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) and in_array($Token, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* A SQL expression for the date an invoice falls due - the same rule the aged debtors report uses */
function CreditDueDateSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ADDDATE(debtortrans.trandate, paymentterms.daysbeforedue)
				ELSE ADDDATE(last_day(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)
			END";
}

/* Returns the credit status of a customer */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Status = array('code' => 0,
					'description' => '',
					'type' => 0,
					'stop' => false,
					'watch' => false);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 1) {
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
		$Status['code'] = $MyRow['holdreason'];
		$Status['description'] = $MyRow['reasondescription'];
		$Status['type'] = $MyRow['dissallowinvoices'];
		$Status['stop'] = ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1);
		$Status['watch'] = ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2);
	}
	return $Status;
}

/* The word shown to staff for a holdreasons.dissallowinvoices value */
function CreditStatusText($DisallowInvoices) {
	if ($DisallowInvoices == 1) {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($DisallowInvoices == 2) {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* Shows a banner when the customer is on stop or on watch. $ForCustomer hides the reason and the watch status from the customer themselves */
function CreditStatusBanner($DebtorNo, $ForCustomer = false) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Status['stop']) {
		if ($ForCustomer) {
			prnMsg(__('Your account is on hold. Please contact us to discuss before placing further orders.'), 'warn');
		} else {
			prnMsg(__('This customer is ON STOP') . ' - ' . $Status['description'] . '. ' . __('No orders can be accepted or dispatched without release by credit control'), 'error');
		}
	} elseif ($Status['watch'] and !$ForCustomer) {
		prnMsg(__('This customer is on WATCH') . ' - ' . $Status['description'] . '. ' . __('Orders may be taken but please contact credit control to discuss'), 'warn');
	}
	return $Status;
}

									userid,
									oldvalue,
									newvalue,
									amount,

	if ($MyRow['creditreleased'] == 1) {
		return '';
	}
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		return __('the customer is on stop');

	if ($MyRow['creditheld'] == 1) {
		return __('the order is held over the credit limit awaiting approval by credit control');

/* Called once the lines of a new or changed order are in the database. Holds the order for credit control's approval

function CreditHoldOrderIfOverLimit($OrderNo) {
	if (isset($_SESSION['CreditHoldOverLimit']) and $_SESSION['CreditHoldOverLimit'] != 1) {

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, quotation, creditheld, creditreleased

				SET alloc = -" . $TotalAllocated . ",
					diffonexch = -" . $TotalDiffOnExch . ",
					settled = IF(ABS(ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount + " . $TotalAllocated . ") < " . $Tolerance . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'",
			__('The credit transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);
}

/* Posts the exchange difference of the allocations of a credit to the ledger as CustomerAllocations.php does */
function CreditPostExchangeDifference($Type, $TransNo, $DiffOnExch) {
	if (abs($DiffOnExch) < 0.00001 or $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] != 1) {
		return;
	}
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$Movement = -$DiffOnExch;
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . $Movement . "')",
			__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
	DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
				VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', CURRENT_DATE, '" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . -$Movement . "')",
			__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
}

/* Writes off $Amount (customer currency) of a customer's unpaid invoices, oldest first. Posts the write-off to the customer
account and the ledger. Must be called inside a transaction. Returns the debtortrans id and transno of the write-off. */
function CreditPostWriteOff($DebtorNo, $Amount, $Reason, $BadDebtAccount) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT currencies.rate, currencies.decimalplaces
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN currencies ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$Currency = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$Posted = CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, -$Amount, __('Bad debt write-off'), $Reason, $BadDebtAccount);

	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$TotalDiff = 0;
	$TotalAllocated = 0;
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, rate, balance
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
							AND settled = 0
							AND balance > 0
						ORDER BY trandate, id");
	while ($Open = DB_fetch_array($Result) and $Remaining > 0) {
		$Portion = min($Remaining, round($Open['balance'], $Currency['decimalplaces']));
		if ($Portion <= 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$TotalDiff += CreditAllocate($Posted['id'], $Posted['rate'], $Open['id'], $Open['rate'], $Portion, $Currency['decimalplaces']);
		$TotalAllocated += $Portion;
		$Remaining -= $Portion;
	}
	CreditSettleTrans($Posted['id'], $TotalAllocated, $TotalDiff, $Currency['decimalplaces']);
	CreditPostExchangeDifference(CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $Posted['transno'], $TotalDiff);
	return $Posted;
}

/* The unsettled debit balance of a customer in the customer currency */
function CreditWriteOffableBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0)
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND type IN (10, " . CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE . ")
							AND settled = 0
							AND balance > 0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

1	# webERP schema: debtor/GL/payment-term table definitions and the gltrans→gltotals triggers
2	
3	Part of [webERP finance and ledger area](weberp-finance-and-ledger-area-152/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	These are install-time SQL definitions for customer transactions, debtor types, fixed asset transactions, GL totals, GL transactions, payment terms and regular payments. Three triggers on `gltrans` keep `gltotals` in step. No application code was searched, so the writers of these tables are not covered here.
6	
7	## Contract
8	- No messages or endpoints. The boundary is table rows.
9	- Anything that inserts, updates or deletes `gltrans` rows makes the triggers write `gltotals(account, period, amount)`.
10	- Foreign keys link to other tables:
11	  - `debtortrans.type` → `systypes.typeid`
12	  - `debtortrans.prd` → `periods.periodno`
13	  - `gltrans.type` → `systypes.typeid`
14	  - `gltrans.periodno` → `periods.periodno`
15	  - `gltrans.account` → `chartmaster.accountcode`
16	
17	### Tables
18	- **`debtortrans`** (InnoDB, utf8mb4):
19	  - Columns:
20	    - `id` int PK auto-increment, `transno` int, `type` smallint, `debtorno` varchar(10), `branchcode` varchar(10)
21	    - `trandate` date (no default), `inputdate` datetime, `prd` smallint
22	    - `settled` tinyint, `reference` varchar(50), `tpe` char(2), `order_` int
23	    - `rate` double, `ovamount` double, `ovgst` double, `ovfreight` double, `ovdiscount` double, `diffonexch` double, `alloc` double
24	    - `invtext` text, `shipvia` int, `edisent` tinyint, `consignment` varchar(20)
25	    - `packages` int DEFAULT 1 (comment 'number of cartons'), `salesperson` varchar(4)
26	    - `balance` double GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount - alloc) STORED
27	  - Indexes: DebtorNo(debtorno, branchcode), Order_, Prd, Tpe, Type, Settled, TranDate, TransNo, Type_2(type, transno), EDISent, salesperson.
28	  - `settled` and `edisent` hold 0 or 1.
29	- **`debtortype`**: `typeid` tinyint auto-increment PK, `typename` varchar(100) NOT NULL.
30	- **`fixedassettrans`**:
31	  - Columns, all NOT NULL: `id` int auto-increment PK, `assetid` int, `transtype` tinyint, `transdate` date, `transno` int, `periodno` smallint, `inputdate` date, `fixedassettranstype` varchar(8), `amount` double.
32	  - Keys: (assetid, transtype, transno), inputdate, transdate.
33	- **`gltotals`**: `account` varchar(20) default '', `period` smallint default 0, `amount` double default 0. PK (account, period).
34	- **`gltrans`**:
35	  - Columns:
36	    - `counterindex` int auto-increment PK
37	    - `type` smallint default 0
38	    - `typeno` bigint default 1
39	    - `chequeno` int default 0
40	    - `trandate` date default '1000-01-01'
41	    - `periodno` smallint default 0
42	    - `account` varchar(20) default '0'
43	    - `narrative` varchar(200) default ''
44	    - `amount` double default 0
45	    - `jobref` varchar(20) default ''
46	  - Indexes: account, chequeno, periodno, trandate, typeno, Type_and_Number(type, typeno), jobref.
47	- **`paymentterms`**: `termsindicator` char(2) PK, `terms` char(40), `daysbeforedue` smallint default 0, `dayinfollowingmonth` smallint default 0. Keys on daysbeforedue and dayinfollowingmonth.
48	- **`regularpayments`**:
49	  - Columns:
50	    - `id` int unsigned auto-increment PK
51	    - `frequency` char(1) default 'M'
52	    - `days` tinyint default 0
53	    - `glcode` varchar(20) default '1'
54	    - `bankaccountcode` varchar(20) default '0'
55	    - `tag` varchar(255) default ''
56	    - `amount` double default 0
57	    - `currabrev` char(3) default ''
58	    - `narrative` varchar(255) NULL
59	    - `firstpayment`, `finalpayment`, `nextpayment` date, each default '1001-01-01'
60	    - `completed` tinyint(1) default 0
61	  - No foreign keys or extra indexes.
62	
63	### Referenced tables
64	- `systypes`: `typeid` smallint PK default 0, `typename` char(50), `typeno` int default 1, index TypeNo.
65	- `periods`: `periodno` smallint PK, `lastdate_in_period` date default 1000-01-01, key on `lastdate_in_period`.
66	- `chartmaster`:
67	  - Columns: `accountcode` varchar(20) PK, `accountname` char(50), `group_` char(30), `cashflowsactivity` tinyint(1) default -1.
68	  - Indexes on `accountname` and `group_`.
69	  - FK `chartmaster_ibfk_1`: `group_` → `accountgroups(groupname)`.
70	
71	## Entry points (triggers on `gltrans`, per row, no guards other than the stated conditions)
72	- **`gltrans_after_insert`**: `INSERT INTO gltotals(account, period, amount) VALUES (NEW.account, NEW.periodno, NEW.amount) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = amount + NEW.amount`.
73	- **`gltrans_after_delete`**: `UPDATE gltotals SET amount = amount - OLD.amount WHERE account = OLD.account AND period = OLD.periodno`.
74	- **`gltrans_after_update`**:
75	  - `if NEW.account <> OLD.account OR NEW.periodno <> OLD.periodno` -> first `UPDATE gltotals` subtracts OLD.amount at the old account/period. Then `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = amount + NEW.amount` adds the new amount at the new account/period.
76	  - `else` -> `UPDATE gltotals SET amount = amount - OLD.amount + NEW.amount WHERE account = NEW.account AND period = NEW.periodno`.
77	
78	## Decisions
79	- Insert creates the `gltotals` row if missing, otherwise adds to it.
80	- Delete and the unchanged-key update only UPDATE, so if no matching `gltotals` row exists they change 0 rows silently.
81	- The account/period-change branch re-creates the total at the new key via upsert, but the deduction at the old key is a plain UPDATE.
82	- `balance` is computed in the database, never written by callers.
83	
84	## Order and failure
85	- The triggers run inside the transaction of the `gltrans` statement. Their failure aborts that statement. None has a handler, a log or an audit trail.
86	- On an account/period change the deduction runs before the add.
87	
88	## Connections
89	- `webERP/install/sql/tables/systypes.sql`: referenced by `debtortrans.type` and `gltrans.type`. `systypes` itself defines no FK back.
90	- `webERP/install/sql/tables/periods.sql`: referenced by `debtortrans.prd` and `gltrans.periodno`.
91	- `webERP/install/sql/tables/chartmaster.sql`: referenced by `gltrans.account`. It has its own FK to `accountgroups`.
92	- `gltotals` is written only by the triggers shown here.
93	
94	## Conclusions
95	- `gltrans` rows must have an existing `chartmaster` account, `systypes` type and `periods` period, or the insert is refused.
96	- `gltotals` is correct only if every change to `gltrans` goes through these triggers. Rows that exist before the triggers are installed are not counted. Any row in `gltrans` with no `gltotals` row is later deleted or edited with a silent 0-row update, so the totals drift.
97	- `debtortrans` has no unique key on transno+type+debtorno, so the same transaction number can be inserted twice. Duplicate `gltrans` inserts double the totals.
98	- `debtortrans.trandate` has no default. `regularpayments` dates default to the sentinel 1001-01-01, and `gltrans.trandate` and `periods.lastdate_in_period` default to 1000-01-01.
99	- Nothing constrains `debtortrans.type` to valid types beyond the `systypes` FK. `regularpayments.frequency` has no check, and its `glcode`, `bankaccountcode` and `currabrev` have no FK, so values pointing at nothing are accepted.
100	- `debtortype`, `fixedassettrans`, `paymentterms` and `regularpayments` carry no FK or trigger in this topic.
101	
102	## Hazards
103	- Deleting or updating a `gltrans` row whose `gltotals` row is missing leaves the totals wrong without any error.
104	- Rows in `regularpayments` or `debtortrans` can reference accounts, banks or currencies that don't exist.
105	- Filtering by `balance` is not indexed.
106	
107	## Open first
108	- `webERP/install/sql/triggers/gltrans_after_update.sql`: the most complex trigger.
109	- `webERP/install/sql/tables/gltrans.sql` and `webERP/install/sql/tables/gltotals.sql`: the pair the triggers maintain.
110	- `webERP/install/sql/tables/debtortrans.sql`: customer transaction schema.

# webERP schema: debtor/GL/payment-term table definitions and the gltrans→gltotals triggers

Part of [webERP finance and ledger area](weberp-finance-and-ledger-area-152/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

These are install-time SQL definitions for customer transactions, debtor types, fixed asset transactions, GL totals, GL transactions, payment terms and regular payments. Three triggers on `gltrans` keep `gltotals` in step. No application code was searched, so the writers of these tables are not covered here.

## Contract
- No messages or endpoints. The boundary is table rows.
- Anything that inserts, updates or deletes `gltrans` rows makes the triggers write `gltotals(account, period, amount)`.
- Foreign keys link to other tables:
  - `debtortrans.type` → `systypes.typeid`
  - `debtortrans.prd` → `periods.periodno`
  - `gltrans.type` → `systypes.typeid`
  - `gltrans.periodno` → `periods.periodno`
  - `gltrans.account` → `chartmaster.accountcode`

### Tables
- **`debtortrans`** (InnoDB, utf8mb4):
  - Columns:
    - `id` int PK auto-increment, `transno` int, `type` smallint, `debtorno` varchar(10), `branchcode` varchar(10)
    - `trandate` date (no default), `inputdate` datetime, `prd` smallint
    - `settled` tinyint, `reference` varchar(50), `tpe` char(2), `order_` int
    - `rate` double, `ovamount` double, `ovgst` double, `ovfreight` double, `ovdiscount` double, `diffonexch` double, `alloc` double
    - `invtext` text, `shipvia` int, `edisent` tinyint, `consignment` varchar(20)
    - `packages` int DEFAULT 1 (comment 'number of cartons'), `salesperson` varchar(4)
    - `balance` double GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount - alloc) STORED
  - Indexes: DebtorNo(debtorno, branchcode), Order_, Prd, Tpe, Type, Settled, TranDate, TransNo, Type_2(type, transno), EDISent, salesperson.
  - `settled` and `edisent` hold 0 or 1.
- **`debtortype`**: `typeid` tinyint auto-increment PK, `typename` varchar(100) NOT NULL.
- **`fixedassettrans`**:
  - Columns, all NOT NULL: `id` int auto-increment PK, `assetid` int, `transtype` tinyint, `transdate` date, `transno` int, `periodno` smallint, `inputdate` date, `fixedassettranstype` varchar(8), `amount` double.
  - Keys: (assetid, transtype, transno), inputdate, transdate.
- **`gltotals`**: `account` varchar(20) default '', `period` smallint default 0, `amount` double default 0. PK (account, period).
- **`gltrans`**:
  - Columns:
    - `counterindex` int auto-increment PK
    - `type` smallint default 0
    - `typeno` bigint default 1
    - `chequeno` int default 0
    - `trandate` date default '1000-01-01'
    - `periodno` smallint default 0
    - `account` varchar(20) default '0'
    - `narrative` varchar(200) default ''
    - `amount` double default 0
    - `jobref` varchar(20) default ''
  - Indexes: account, chequeno, periodno, trandate, typeno, Type_and_Number(type, typeno), jobref.
- **`paymentterms`**: `termsindicator` char(2) PK, `terms` char(40), `daysbeforedue` smallint default 0, `dayinfollowingmonth` smallint default 0. Keys on daysbeforedue and dayinfollowingmonth.
- **`regularpayments`**:
  - Columns:
    - `id` int unsigned auto-increment PK
    - `frequency` char(1) default 'M'
    - `days` tinyint default 0
    - `glcode` varchar(20) default '1'
    - `bankaccountcode` varchar(20) default '0'
    - `tag` varchar(255) default ''
    - `amount` double default 0
    - `currabrev` char(3) default ''
    - `narrative` varchar(255) NULL
    - `firstpayment`, `finalpayment`, `nextpayment` date, each default '1001-01-01'
    - `completed` tinyint(1) default 0
  - No foreign keys or extra indexes.

### Referenced tables
- `systypes`: `typeid` smallint PK default 0, `typename` char(50), `typeno` int default 1, index TypeNo.
- `periods`: `periodno` smallint PK, `lastdate_in_period` date default 1000-01-01, key on `lastdate_in_period`.
- `chartmaster`:
  - Columns: `accountcode` varchar(20) PK, `accountname` char(50), `group_` char(30), `cashflowsactivity` tinyint(1) default -1.
  - Indexes on `accountname` and `group_`.
  - FK `chartmaster_ibfk_1`: `group_` → `accountgroups(groupname)`.

## Entry points (triggers on `gltrans`, per row, no guards other than the stated conditions)
- **`gltrans_after_insert`**: `INSERT INTO gltotals(account, period, amount) VALUES (NEW.account, NEW.periodno, NEW.amount) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = amount + NEW.amount`.
- **`gltrans_after_delete`**: `UPDATE gltotals SET amount = amount - OLD.amount WHERE account = OLD.account AND period = OLD.periodno`.
- **`gltrans_after_update`**:
  - `if NEW.account <> OLD.account OR NEW.periodno <> OLD.periodno` -> first `UPDATE gltotals` subtracts OLD.amount at the old account/period. Then `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE amount = amount + NEW.amount` adds the new amount at the new account/period.
  - `else` -> `UPDATE gltotals SET amount = amount - OLD.amount + NEW.amount WHERE account = NEW.account AND period = NEW.periodno`.

## Decisions
- Insert creates the `gltotals` row if missing, otherwise adds to it.
- Delete and the unchanged-key update only UPDATE, so if no matching `gltotals` row exists they change 0 rows silently.
- The account/period-change branch re-creates the total at the new key via upsert, but the deduction at the old key is a plain UPDATE.
- `balance` is computed in the database, never written by callers.

## Order and failure
- The triggers run inside the transaction of the `gltrans` statement. Their failure aborts that statement. None has a handler, a log or an audit trail.
- On an account/period change the deduction runs before the add.

## Connections
- `webERP/install/sql/tables/systypes.sql`: referenced by `debtortrans.type` and `gltrans.type`. `systypes` itself defines no FK back.
- `webERP/install/sql/tables/periods.sql`: referenced by `debtortrans.prd` and `gltrans.periodno`.
- `webERP/install/sql/tables/chartmaster.sql`: referenced by `gltrans.account`. It has its own FK to `accountgroups`.
- `gltotals` is written only by the triggers shown here.

## Conclusions
- `gltrans` rows must have an existing `chartmaster` account, `systypes` type and `periods` period, or the insert is refused.
- `gltotals` is correct only if every change to `gltrans` goes through these triggers. Rows that exist before the triggers are installed are not counted. Any row in `gltrans` with no `gltotals` row is later deleted or edited with a silent 0-row update, so the totals drift.
- `debtortrans` has no unique key on transno+type+debtorno, so the same transaction number can be inserted twice. Duplicate `gltrans` inserts double the totals.
- `debtortrans.trandate` has no default. `regularpayments` dates default to the sentinel 1001-01-01, and `gltrans.trandate` and `periods.lastdate_in_period` default to 1000-01-01.
- Nothing constrains `debtortrans.type` to valid types beyond the `systypes` FK. `regularpayments.frequency` has no check, and its `glcode`, `bankaccountcode` and `currabrev` have no FK, so values pointing at nothing are accepted.
- `debtortype`, `fixedassettrans`, `paymentterms` and `regularpayments` carry no FK or trigger in this topic.

## Hazards
- Deleting or updating a `gltrans` row whose `gltotals` row is missing leaves the totals wrong without any error.
- Rows in `regularpayments` or `debtortrans` can reference accounts, banks or currencies that don't exist.
- Filtering by `balance` is not indexed.

## Open first
- `webERP/install/sql/triggers/gltrans_after_update.sql`: the most complex trigger.
- `webERP/install/sql/tables/gltrans.sql` and `webERP/install/sql/tables/gltotals.sql`: the pair the triggers maintain.
- `webERP/install/sql/tables/debtortrans.sql`: customer transaction schema.

101	The page behaviour below comes from the condensations of the pages that use these tables. Those pages are not part of this topic.
102	
103	- **`webERP/SecurityTokens.php`** writes `securitytokens`.
104	  - Insert and update need a numeric, non-empty `TokenId` and a non-empty `TokenDescription`.
105	  - Insert warns "Token ID already used" if the id exists.
106	  - Delete is refused if the token is used in the scripts `pagesecurity` or in the security roles.
107	  - Links to edit and delete are disabled for the fixed tokens 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 11, 12, 15, 18, 19, 20.
108	  - If `AllowDemoMode` is true, the page prints a warning and exits.
109	  - There is no transaction handling.

113	  - `SectionName` must be non-empty and free of illegal characters.
114	  - Insert is refused if the id already exists.
115	  - Delete is refused if `accountgroups.sectioninaccounts` references the section.
116	  - Sections 1 and 2 show "Restricted" instead of a delete link.
117	  - The page has no permission check.
118	- **`webERP/Departments.php`** writes `departments`.
119	  - The name must be non-empty and free of illegal characters, and must not duplicate an existing name (`LIKE` match).
120	  - Edit and delete address the row by the old description (`WHERE description LIKE OldDepartmentName`), not by `departmentid`.
121	  - Delete is refused if `stockrequest` rows exist for the department.
122	  - Create and edit run in a transaction: any query failure sets `InputError=1`, and the page rolls back.
123	- **`webERP/Employees.php`** writes `employees`.
124	  - `Surname` and `FirstName` must be non-empty.
125	  - The stock choice list comes from `stockmaster` joined to `stockcategory` where `stocktype='L'`.
126	  - The manager choice list comes from `employees`.
127	  - The user choice list comes from `www_users`.
128	  - Delete runs unless `CancelDelete` is set; the timesheets dependency check is commented out.
129	  - There is no duplicate check on `UserID` or email, and no cycle check on managers.
130	- **`webERP/WWW_Users.php`** writes `www_users`.
131	  - A new user also gets a `locationusers` row and `glaccountusers` rows for every `chartmaster` account, each with canview=1 and canupd=1.
132	  - Delete is refused if `audittrail` has entries for the user.
133	  - Otherwise delete removes rows in this order: `locationusers`, `glaccountusers`, `bankaccountusers`, `purchorderauth`, `sessions`, `session_data`, `www_users`.
134	- **`webERP/Logout.php`** writes `session_data`. It deletes the user's row where `field='module'` and inserts `(userid, 'module', $_SESSION['Module'])`. It then deletes the `sessions` row for the current session id.
135	- **`webERP/index.php`** reads `session_data`: `SELECT value FROM session_data WHERE userid=...`, to restore the module when no module is stored in the session.
136	- **`webERP/sql/updates/6.php`** is the upgrade path. It creates `session_data` with the same shape as the install file. It adds `www_users.timeout` as TINYINT NOT NULL default 5 after `pagesize`. It calls `UpdateDBNo('6', ...)` only if `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0`, and it has no error handling around its steps.
137	
138	## Conclusions
139	- In `session_data` the key is (userid, value), not (userid, field). One user can have several `field='module'` rows with different values, and the same value cannot be stored twice for a user. `Logout.php` deletes the user's `field='module'` row before inserting a new one, so only one module row normally exists. `index.php` reads `value` by `userid` and the condensation does not show it filtering on `field`.
140	- `session_data` has no foreign key to `www_users` and no expiry column. `WWW_Users.php` is what removes a user's rows, and it does so at user deletion.
141	- `departments.authoriser` has no foreign key and no index. Nothing in the schema stops a department from naming a user who does not exist. `Departments.php` identifies rows by description (`LIKE`), so a name containing `%` or `_` can match other departments.
142	- `departments` has no unique index on `description`. Only the page enforces uniqueness, so any other writer bypasses it.
143	- `reportlinks` has no primary key, so duplicate rows are possible.
144	- `accountsection` has no foreign key from `accountgroups.sectioninaccounts`; the delete refusal exists only in `AccountSections.php`.
145	- Deleting a security token is guarded only in `SecurityTokens.php`, because `securitytokens` has no referential constraints.
146	- The `www_users.timeout` default is 5 in both the install file and `6.php`, so a fresh install and an upgraded database match on that column.
147	- Changing a column here does not change the update scripts. Each update script (such as `sql/updates/6.php`) keeps its own copy of the definition, so a fresh install and an upgraded database can differ.
148	
149	## Hazards
150	- Rows saved in `session_data` with the same `value` for different fields collide on the primary key.
